codeReview.summary: The page delivers agent selection, sectioned contract rendering with inheritance badges, raw/resolved toggle, diff mode, and sidebar accessibility, but rollback is implemented against a redacted config payload and can erase secret/token values instead of restoring true prior state.

issues.description: Rollback snapshots are captured from GET /api/admin/config and replayed with PATCH /api/admin/config (lines 342 and 364). The backend returns cfg.Redacted() for that GET (internal/channels/dashboard/handler.go:450), so snapshot data strips provider API keys and chat tokens. Restoring such a snapshot can overwrite live secrets with empty values, violating expected rollback behavior (restore previous config state) and creating destructive side effects.
